event_detail: Stove: the burner under the kettle on the LEFT side is lit (blue flame from 27.2 s on), not the front right burner; afterwards the gripper moves right and hovers over the steel pot without turning the front right knob.
evidence: The brown kettle stands upright on a left burner in every frame (stage 1 looks done), with a blue flame ring under it from the first frame on. At 27.2 s the wrist camera is at a front knob that has been turned; at 28.8-32.0 s the arm swings right and the wrist camera looks down into the steel pot on the right side of the stove. No flame is visible on the right-hand burners in any frame. If the intended burner is simply the one under the kettle, stage 2 would be done instead; by the stage text (front right burner) it is not.
